text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I won against Opera O. My
heart's
thumping so fast...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Egad... how can this be?! In the face of
this sacred
plaque, to think I'd be left in
Doto's dust!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, this will serve as a building
block for our next engagement! For I
have obtained a
sword that has no
equal!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wow, what a sword.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Doto and Opera O are getting
pretty good.
You think they're up there
with the Ultimate
Generation?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Nah, they're not that fast. Today's race felt a little sluggish to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Today was within the margin of error,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Their status has yet to be overturned.
Opera O is
still ahead with Doto
struggling to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yet the Ultimate Generation are out
there
screwing up the whole meaning of
"top." Those
two can hardly compare.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it was great,
but... I think I
ran
pretty well today. Maybe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O! Does this mean... Does
this mean I
passed?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And by "passed," I mean... am I shining
bright?
Bright enough to be considered
your partner?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying, Doto! You are
like my
right arm, irreplaceable to me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, would you care to run in the Japan
Cup next? We need something to
preface our
generational takeover at the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There we will display our unbreakable
bond to
the world! Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Sure th-thing, Opera O. Oh, I'm so
glad...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your help, Opera O told me I
was like
her right arm.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling I should have pushed
myself a little more... But it's okay,
because Opera O
approves of me.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that... I have my answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it turns out it was right in front of
me all
along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ceiling holding her back... is the
very reason
she's made it this far—her
salvation, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's her feelings toward T.M. Opera
O—and her
reservations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's only one individual I can look to
for
advice. I ask Admire Vega her
opinion on the
matter.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's just as I thought...
This race has made
it clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To speak the truth, Doto's never had
confidence.
Not even now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
This entire time, everything she thinks
can be traced back to Opera
O—supporting, following,
and getting
her approval.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She even relies on Opera O to determine
if she
shines.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But that lack of confidence and her
resulting
stagnation are also affecting
Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
At present, T.M. Opera O is one of the
faces of
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She needs a strong rival to push her limits too. Ideally, she and Doto would inspire each other, but that's not what's happening...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She could be right about that. Meisho
Doto isn't
the only one who is
stagnating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But one day, Meisho Doto will see this
for herself
and awaken.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That won't happen. Probably.
choice_data_list: If only she would awaken like she ...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Try to remember what actually
happened last fall.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto didn't spark that awakening. She
just let it
happen to her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
After my accident, when I dropped out
of racing...
Doto got pressured into
changing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She's not going to take the initiative to
change
on her own. Because... she's too
nice to make an
enemy out of her idol.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She knows it, and we do too. Far too
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...She's right. Meisho Doto would never
make that
decision on her own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If she's going to truly awaken to her full

potential—if she's to become the person
she
wants to be...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Someone else will have to give her the
push. Even
if that makes them the villain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear to me now that I need to sit
down with
Meisho Doto before the
Japan Cup... no matter
what.
